title: Django applications
description: For a Django project: migrations, deployment settings, form fields, raw SQL, CSRF exemptions and query counts.

sources.title: Django ModelForm, selecting the fields to use

rules.instruction: Generate the migration for each model change with makemigrations and commit it in the same change as the model.
rules.verification: Run `python manage.py makemigrations --check` in CI and confirm it exits with status 0 on the branch.

rules.instruction: Give each RunPython operation a reverse callable, or record in the migration why it cannot be reversed. Review the SQL of schema migrations on large tables before merging.
rules.verification: Migrate forward and back to the previous migration on a test database, and attach the `sqlmigrate` output for migrations that touch large tables.

rules.instruction: Keep DEBUG off, read SECRET_KEY from the environment and set ALLOWED_HOSTS in the production settings.
rules.verification: Run `python manage.py check --deploy` with the production settings module and record how each remaining warning is handled.

rules.instruction: List the editable fields of each ModelForm in `fields`. Do not use `__all__` or `exclude` on forms that users submit.
rules.verification: task verify checks the forms modules for `fields = "__all__"`; search the changed forms for `exclude`, and test that a submitted field outside the list leaves the model unchanged.

rules.instruction: Pass user-controlled values to raw(), RawSQL, extra() and cursor.execute() as query parameters, never by string formatting.
rules.verification: Search the change for raw SQL calls built with f-strings, % or format(), and test the query with a value containing a quote.

rules.instruction: Keep CsrfViewMiddleware enabled. Add `csrf_exempt` only to a view that authenticates without cookies, with the reason in the code review.
rules.verification: Search the change for `csrf_exempt` and test that a POST without the CSRF token is rejected on the changed cookie-authenticated views.

rules.instruction: Load the related objects a changed list view or serializer reads with the FETCH_PEERS fetch mode, select_related() or prefetch_related().
rules.verification: Assert the number of queries of the changed view with `assertNumQueries` on a fixture holding several related records.
